integrity: All claims are conditional on the explicit graph/model assumptions. The finite standard-library checker is supporting evidence only; an analytic proof is supplied. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected graphs with independent real or complex edge weights; derivative means real Fréchet differentiability at nonzero vectors only. Perron perturbation theory and Ridge’s periodic shift formula are prior work. The comparison could not fully inspect the Ridge, Nussbaum, and Wang–Wu original articles, so exact equivalent prior coverage remains a residual originality risk. Numerical finite tests are not exhaustive proofs of the all-graph theorem.
title: Strict convexity and the full smooth locus of graph-edge numerical-radius norms
